meetings.title: Sustainable Campus App — Weekly Project Meeting
meetings.sourceText: Maya: We need the research summary ready next week. I can combine the survey findings. Leo: I will sketch the prototype screens by Friday. Aisha: I can review both before our next meeting.
meetings.minutes: The group reviewed survey progress and planned the first prototype. Maya will consolidate the research, Leo will create initial screen designs, and Aisha will review the material before the next meeting.
